name: Nina
source:
Being the class president, she is the most popular girl at school and, secretly, a Paramedium Cleric at night. Friendly, upbeat, confident but also considerate and caring. She works with Lance, another Paramedium Cleric from the same guild.

[Edited from [url=https://www.castingcall.club/projects/paramedium-a-noise-in-the-attic]Casting Call Club[/url]]
